# Role Definition Template

Use this template when defining or updating roles in your project documentation. Copy and customize each section to match your team's needs.

---

## [Role Name]

### Role Summary
_Provide a 1-2 sentence description of the role's primary purpose and scope._

### Key Responsibilities
_List the main duties and accountabilities for this role. Be specific and action-oriented._
- Responsibility 1
- Responsibility 2
- Responsibility 3
- ...

### Interactions with existing roles
_Describe how this role collaborates with other team members. Include communication patterns and handoff points._
- **[Role A]**: Description of interaction and collaboration points.
- **[Role B]**: Description of interaction and collaboration points.
- **[Role C]**: Description of interaction and collaboration points.

### Typical Communication
_Outline the standard communication methods, artifacts, and cadences for this role._
- Communication method 1 (e.g., daily standups, design reviews)
- Communication artifact 2 (e.g., status reports, design docs)
- ...

### Onboarding Checklist
_List the key steps to onboard someone into this role on a new project. See also: [role-onboarding-checklist.md](role-onboarding-checklist.md)_
- [ ] Step 1: Assign role owner and document in project charter
- [ ] Step 2: Grant access to relevant tools and repositories
- [ ] Step 3: Schedule introduction meeting with key stakeholders
- [ ] Step 4: Review project context and deliverables
- [ ] Step 5: Define success criteria and acceptance measures

### Example Success Criteria
_Provide measurable or observable indicators of success for this role (optional but recommended)._
- Success criterion 1 (e.g., "All design deliverables reviewed and approved within 2 business days")
- Success criterion 2 (e.g., "Test coverage maintained above 80% for new features")
- ...

### Suggested RACI Links
_Reference any RACI matrices or responsibility assignment documents where this role appears._
- Link to RACI matrix or responsibility doc
- Link to decision log or escalation procedure
- ...

---

## Notes
- Keep role definitions concise and actionable.
- Update this template as your team's processes evolve.
- Link to this template from your project overview and onboarding documentation.
